evidence: The spatial density, average size, size distribution, and average height of Ru as a function of the number of ALD cycles were measured using plan-view and cross-sectional transmission electron microscopy (TEM)/H20849JEOL JEM-3000F with a field emission gun operated at 300 kV /H20850 and scanning electron microscopy /H20849JEOL JSM 7401F/H20850. Capacitance-voltage /H20849C-V/H20850 measurement was conducted using an Agilent 4284A precision LCR meter.
